scope: durable storage billing restoration and generation fencing
environment: Local-only validation. Billing and database checks used disposable loopback PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:55432; credentials and connection values are omitted. No production database, storage provider, deployment, or external identity provider was contacted.

checks.command: CI=true node_modules/.bin/vitest run packages/storage/test/recovery.test.ts packages/storage/test/storage.test.ts packages/storage/test/http.test.ts packages/core/test/storage-recovery.test.ts apps/web/src/runtime-storage-recovery-mount.test.ts packages/authoring/test/billing.test.ts packages/billing/test/index.test.ts --no-file-parallelism

coveredAreas: ledger-owned restoreUsage compensation bypasses ordinary quota admission while preserving future cap enforcement
restoration records persist source reservation key, source generation, target generation, and exact storage delta
lost restoration responses replay through the durable exact operation key without a second usage write
stale generation-zero callbacks are rejected after G2 restoration and after later G3 re-admission
PostgreSQL exact-key lookup survives bounded operation-window eviction and a fresh BillingService instance
storage recovery persists G2 before clearing restore-pending and remains fail-closed without restoreUsage
the PostgreSQL-backed StorageRecoveryService bridge exercises quota refill, late metadata reference, lost restore response, restart replay, stale G1 zero, and G2 cleanup
limits: provider finality remains false for the built-in hosted adapter unless the host supplies a terminal write proof
hosted storage recovery and production deployment acceptance remain open
crash-after-zero recovery closure and authoring ownership follow-ups remain pending separate owner patches
this evidence record does not establish release readiness
